title: Attack Patterns in Cross-Chain Bridges: Dataset, Codebook, and Analysis
description: Dataset, codebook, and analysis scripts for an empirical study of 48 evidence-supported cross-chain bridge attack incidents (January 2022 to August 2026; USD 2.676 billion in gross bridge-specific losses). Each incident is classified into one of six trust-violation attack patterns and one of five functional domains, with evidence levels, normalised losses, loss basis, classification rationale, boundary-case alternatives, and excluded candidates. The scripts reproduce all tables and figures in the accompanying paper.
